title: The debt grows: petrodollars and cheap loans
goal: Read how oil money and easy loans took Latin American governments into debt, using debido a and a raíz de.
grammar: formal cause connectors: debido a, a raíz de

items: I can say how the oil money of the 1970s ended up in loans to Latin American governments.
I can name some of the countries that borrowed the most and say what the money was used for.
I can explain why loans with a variable interest rate were a danger.
I can link a cause to its result with *debido a* and *a raíz de*.
